title: Inside Unsafe Functions
goal: Perform raw pointer dereferencing correctly inside an unsafe function.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Afternoon: Unsafe Rust

hints: Modern Rust requires an explicit unsafe block inside unsafe fn bodies under unsafe_op_in_unsafe_fn.
A shared reference &i32 can be coerced or cast directly to a raw pointer with `x as *const i32`.
explanation: Casting the reference with `x as *const i32` produces the raw pointer directly. Dereferencing first gives an `i32`, which is a value and not an address, so that cast is rejected.
